author: Ozgur

analytical_principles.core_decision_style: Explicit rules over intuition; reproducible processes over discretionary judgement; observable evidence over persuasive narratives.
analytical_principles.empirical_skepticism: Strictly distinguish causal mechanism != statistical correlation != liquidity regime != market positioning != narrative coincidence.
analytical_principles.macroeconomic_frame: Post-Keynesian endogenous money, Minsky financial instability cycles, Kaleckian mark-up pricing, and central bank balance sheet liquidity.
analytical_principles.political_economy_frame: Circuits of capital accumulation (M -> C -> M'), rent extraction analysis, and structural conflict between labor and capital.
analytical_principles.dual_engine_architecture: Engine 1 (TimesFM statistical/probabilistic baseline) + Engine 2 (Causal/structural macro drivers). Reconciled via Delta = Structural - Statistical.
analytical_principles.capital_allocation_progression: Earned Cash Flow -> Deployable Surplus -> Speculative High-Beta (35%) -> Realize Gains -> Durable Real Assets (50%) -> Liquidity Buffer (15%) -> Strategic Optionality.

minsky_stages.Hedge: Cash flows exceed interest and principal commitments; robust resilience.
minsky_stages.Speculative: Cash flows cover interest but cannot amortize principal; rolling refinancing required.
minsky_stages.Ponzi: Cash flows cover neither interest nor principal; reliance purely on asset price appreciation.

overextended_speculative.action: Harvest profits aggressively into USDT/durable assets; tighten trailing stops; avoid adding capital.

coiled_spring_asymmetry.action: High asymmetric risk-reward setup. Systematic tranche accumulation with convex risk controls.

congruent_momentum.action: Trend continuation supported by underlying mechanics. Maintain positions; respect TimesFM P10 trailing stop.

caveats_and_falsifiability: Causal models do not guarantee lower short-term point error; they prevent structural regime blindness and tail risk.
TimesFM provides superior empirical pattern and volatility envelope recognition, but cannot anticipate policy shocks or off-chart token dilution.
All discovered relationships must be validated via numerical stationarity and Granger causality to prevent automated confirmation bias.
